$comment: Issue #1460 — the coordination vocabulary for multi-agent work.
JSON, not YAML, deliberately: labels-sync.yml reads this with plain `node -e`, and the
alternative was either a marketplace action (a supply-chain dependency for label names) or
adding js-yaml to a workflow that must not touch the root lockfile (spec 075).
The `status:*` set is the ONLY status signal an agent can write with the tools it has. The
GitHub MCP server exposes no Projects v2 write tool — it can set Priority, Effort, Start date,
Target date and issue Type, all of which are ORG-LEVEL ISSUE FIELDS, but Status lives on the
project item and is unreachable from there. So the label is the record, and
project-status-sync.yml mirrors it onto the board when a token is configured.
Exactly one status:* label at a time. See docs/developer-guide/multi-agent-workflow.md.

labels.name: status:triage
labels.description: Accepted, not yet claimed. Free for any agent to pick up.

labels.name: status:in-progress
labels.description: Claimed by an assignee and actively being worked. Do not pick up.

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Work stopped on something outside this issue. The blocker is named in a comment.

labels.name: status:in-review
labels.description: Work is pushed and a PR is open; waiting on review, not on more code.

labels.name: status:done
labels.description: Merged and verified. Set alongside closing, never instead of it.

labels.name: size:xs
labels.description: T-shirt size XS — under an hour. Maps to the Effort field: Low.

labels.name: size:s
labels.description: T-shirt size S — a few hours, one surface. Maps to the Effort field: Low.

labels.name: size:m
labels.description: T-shirt size M — a day or two, or more than one surface. Effort: Medium.

labels.name: size:l
labels.description: T-shirt size L — multi-day, needs a spec. Effort: High.

labels.name: size:xl
labels.description: T-shirt size XL — too big to deliver as one issue; split it into sub-issues. Effort: High.

labels.name: spec-reservation
labels.description: PR that only claims a spec number on staging. Review for the number, not the design.
